subject: SecurityPkg: Refactor performance to use new PERF_FUNCTION_* measurements
reasons: Systematic macro migration: replaces PERF_START_EX(handle, token, module, 0, PERF_ID_*) with PERF_FUNCTION_BEGIN() and PERF_END_EX(...) with PERF_FUNCTION_END()
Applied in two files (Tcg2Dxe.c and Tcg2Pei.c) within SecurityPkg, with matching neighbor commits (03e7c8c44f for MdeModulePkg) doing the same migration — forms an N-commit series
The PERF_START_EX/PERF_END_EX -> PERF_FUNCTION_BEGIN/PERF_FUNCTION_END pattern is a well-defined collateral evolution across the edk2 codebase
Coccinelle can match the PERF_START_EX call with its characteristic arguments and replace it, and similarly for PERF_END_EX
